answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy places every new identity behind a quartz bond locked for 19 epochs. Two randomly chosen auditors must reproduce each task, and a failed audit burns 20 percent of the bond. A delta quota limits each sponsor to two identities per epoch, while an ember registry compares signed output fingerprints and quarantines correlated accounts. Full rewards unlock only after six clean rounds, so each fake identity adds capital, audit exposure, and delay; task hashes keep every decision independently verifiable.
